name: kill-after-background
description: Background, then kill the process 5s later. Tests whether backgrounding work completes before process death.

steps.why: clear the stats.minimum_upload_interval_ms floor (30s default, not the 5s upload cadence). Shorter and the ON_STOP upload is refused, so the run measures the gate instead of the question.
roughly matches the OS background network cutoff, so the kill lands in the same window
